source_skin_association: All vertices dominant within finger skeleton group, at least one distal; actual saved MANO faces; no LBS rerun
source_uncertainty: Exploratory 8mm allowance on inferred skin, not a measured confidence interval; original source flags/failures retained
site_rank: Lowest maximum gravity/motion total solved normal force within each finite pool, then source gap; never select source-pose truth
new_robot_pose_method: One coupled SLSQP solve per available new seed; actual native distal triangle barycentrics, 7 actual URDF joint ranges, root residual 8mm/.08rad per component; force variables for both loads and native effort constraints including gravity; no old prior/local-search controls repeated
native_motor_cap_source: Pinned compiled model per-joint actuatorfrcrange .76Nm, including actuator gravity compensation; actual dof frictionloss explicit
